sources.entry: 13. Noonshot for Midjourney - Noonshot app with features for Midjourney.

summary.name: Noonshot Midjourney Prompt Generator
summary.one_liner: A free web tool that helps build Midjourney prompts by letting you set parameters, style presets, and prompt weights, then copy the result to run in Midjourney.
use_cases: Building a Midjourney prompt without memorizing parameters
Setting aspect ratio for a Midjourney image
Increasing variation with the chaos parameter
Weighting parts of a prompt in Midjourney
summary.what_it_does: The tool provides a prompt helper where you type the main concept for an image, then set Midjourney parameters such as aspect ratio and chaos. You can apply style presets and assign weights to parts of the prompt, with the page noting that a weight of 5 is strongly followed and 1 is lightly considered. Once the prompt is finished, you copy it to your clipboard and run it in the Midjourney bot. The page says prompts can be saved to a PromptFolder account for later use.
notable: Parameter helper for aspect ratio, chaos and other Midjourney options
Style presets and prompt weighting controls
Saves prompts to a PromptFolder account
caveats: Generated prompts must be run separately in the Midjourney bot; the tool does not generate images itself
Saving prompts requires a PromptFolder account
